response_text: The benefits would be a greater OS clock speed and resolution, meaning that the OS can respond to events faster, and do things such as context switching more frequently. This can be important in time-critical applications where different threads need to update different values very rapidly. However, this would also introduce significant overhead, as the SysTick interrupt would be triggered 10 times more frequently, meaning that SysTick_Handler would have to run 10 times more.\n
